author.name: Machina Memorialis » Blog Archive » Editing, The Shire in Oregon, CCCC, and the Auction of a Lifetime

message: [...] Finally, I’ll add my voice to those announcing their acceptance letters for CCCC 2007. I got two. Both my panel “25 Years of Reading and Misreading Orality and Literacy” and Kathie Gossett’s “The Forgotten Canon” roundtable on memory, for which I’m a panelist, were accepted. Now that I know the CCCC Ong session’s a go, I’ll get the Orality and Literacy 25th anniversary web site up with abstracts and everything. I’ll probably post the names and titles for both sessions here before the page is up. [...]
